args: original=$(cmd uimode night) || exit; original=${original##* }; case "$original" in yes) changed=no;; no|auto) changed=yes;; *) echo "Unexpected mode: $original"; exit 1;; esac; cleanup() { result=$?; trap - EXIT; cmd uimode night "$original" >/dev/null || result=1; restored=$(cmd uimode night) || result=1; restored=${restored##* }; echo "restored=$restored"; [ "$restored" = "$original" ] || result=1; exit "$result"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; echo "original=$original"; cmd uimode night "$changed" >/dev/null || exit; observed=$(cmd uimode night) || exit; observed=${observed##* }; echo "changed=$observed"; [ "$observed" = "$changed" ] || exit 1
